dct_description_sm: The Chippewas of Georgina Island First Nation is located both on and off the east shore of Lake Simcoe. A culture of respect for the natural environment is championed from Chief and Council through the Band policies and emanates to operations via all departments within the Band, still the sensitivity of the natural environment to changes in weather and climate affect the ecosystems and the socioeconomic aspects of the community. While policy and actions to protect and enhance the health of ecosystems and the people who live in the community have been carefully developed and enacted, climate variability and climate change impacts will challenge the adaptive capacity of the different systems. Community-level vulnerabilities can be identified and assessed most appropriately through a collaborative community effort, thus the objective of this project was to develop a climate change adaptation plan for the Georgina Island First Nation.
